info.title: Editarr
info.description: Local Editarr API. X-Api-Key grants administrator access. Browser sessions require same-origin CSRF protection for mutations.

get.description: The caller's key metadata; the value itself is only returned by reveal.

post.description: Create or replace the caller's key; the previous key stops working immediately.

delete.description: Disable the caller's key without affecting browser sessions.

post.description: Show the caller's current key after password confirmation.
Make a Jellyfin administrator the owner, store Editarr's minted key, and sign in.

get.description: Return safe setup/authentication state without exposing credentials.

post.description: Revoke only this browser's session and clear exactly its cookie.
Issue a session for a valid Jellyfin user, creating its account when admission allows.

get.description:
Whether sign-in offers Quick Connect: Jellyfin is configured, reachable, and allows it.

One request at a time asks Jellyfin; the answer is reused for ten seconds,
or three after Jellyfin did not answer.

post.description: Start a Quick Connect sign-in for this browser, replacing its earlier one.

get.description:
Ask Jellyfin whether this browser's code was approved, and report the attempt's state.

Jellyfin is asked at most once a second per attempt; between asks the last
known state is reported. A code Jellyfin no longer knows, or one left when
Quick Connect was turned off, is expired. An outage leaves the attempt pending and answers 503.

post.description:
Spend this browser's approved code and sign its Jellyfin user in, as password sign-in does.

The code is spent before Jellyfin is asked, so it signs in at most once.
Cancel this browser's Quick Connect sign-in; its code can no longer sign in here.
Create or replace another account's key (owner only).

delete.description: Revoke another account's key: the owner any, an admin an ordinary user's.

post.description: Show another account's key (owner only).

get.description: One page of archived items; paths appear only for callers who may see media paths.
The mode new accounts start in.

put.description: Change the mode new accounts start in; existing accounts keep theirs.

get.description: The caller's effective defaults; every account may read its own.

put.description: Replace the caller's values for their current mode.
Choose the caller's mode; refused while a policy is enforced on the caller.

get.description: Another account's effective defaults, for those who manage its values, mode, or policy.

put.description: Replace another account's values (owner by default).
Assign an account's mode; enforcement still applies in either mode.
Replace the rules and severities enforced on an account (owner, fresh password).

Disable or re-enable another account. Disabling ends its sessions and keeps its data.

An account without a Jellyfin link stays disabled (`account_link_required`).

delete.description: End every browser session of another account; its API key keeps working.

put.description: Make another account an admin or an ordinary user (owner only).

post.description:
Apply one operation to each listed account, checking every target on its own.

Targets are processed in order and each change commits alone. A wrong or
throttled password stops the request with that refusal; changes already
applied stay applied.

get.description: One page of the directory with the approved columns, for admins and the owner.
One account's profile: the caller's own, or any account for directory readers.

put.description: Replace a local account's avatar with an uploaded PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF image.

get.description: The stored avatar as PNG; its digest is the ETag.

post.description:
Make another account the owner; the caller becomes an admin.

Refusals: 409 `own_account`, 409 `successor_disabled`, 409
`successor_credentials_required`, 409 `permission_revision_stale` when the
caller's permissions changed during the request, and the access codes.

get.description: Another account's role, stored overrides, and effective capabilities (owner only).

patch.description: Allow, deny, or inherit the listed capabilities for another account (owner only).

get.description: Every delegable capability's default for admins and users (owner only).

patch.description: Change the listed defaults; accounts of that role without an override follow live.

get.description: The live local default every local account without its own selection follows.

put.description: Replace the live local default; it cannot be `inherit`.

get.description: Another account's own selection, or the default it follows.

put.description: Store a local account's own selection, or return it to the default with `inherit`.

post.description:
Prove the target account and a Jellyfin identity; return a proof and the preview.

The proof expires after ten minutes, works once, and only for this caller's
session and this account.

Link or relink an account with a proof from `/link/proof` and its confirmation.

New export files are written first; the identity and publications change in
one transaction; old files are removed only after that commits. A failure
before the commit leaves the old identity and files. `removing` reports old
files that recovery removes later.

get.description: Describe what deleting another account in `mode` does to each of its resources.

post.description: Delete another account exactly as previewed; the request carries the caller's password.

Delete each listed account with its own confirmation, committing each alone.

Every target is authorized and confirmed on its own, and the password is
verified once. A refusal or an operational failure of one target names its
code after that target rolls back; earlier targets stay applied and later ones
still run. A wrong or throttled password stops the request.

get.description: Jellyfin users that may be imported, with any linked account.

post.description: Create accounts for the selected or all Jellyfin users; report each one.

get.description: The last sync run and every linked account's verification state.

post.description: Refresh every linked account now and return each account's result.

get.description: Jellyfin users kept out when their accounts were deleted, newest first.

post.description:
Let a blocked Jellyfin user sign in or be imported again; their next sign-in
creates a fresh account.
Start a full export.
Match the target's keys against the service and remember them under a `findKey`.

get.description: The approved aliases for the version picker: Theatrical first, Other last.

post.description: Download, verify and link a found version to the target's local version.

get.description: The caller's links for one item version.
The master view: the link, the saved preferences and every row in the local set.

The link's filters that start enabled in a review, on the local timeline now,
and their merged Simple EDL; `clipped=false` returns them unclipped.

post.description: Fit a transform and show every row on the local timeline; nothing is stored.
Store the previewed transform for `for_revision` and return the link.

get.description: The account's master-set display preferences, or the defaults.

patch.description:
Save any preference. The threshold and Low Confidence toggle decide which community
filters start enabled when a review includes or refreshes them; hiding downvoted
rows affects only the list.

post.description: Persist the vote intent, send it with the link's receipt and record `myVote`.
Resend a saved vote intent's exact bytes.
Report the link's version or one of its served filters to moderators.
Download and apply a newer revision without using the daily sync allowance.

get.description: The account's sync state and its newest notifications.

post.description: Run the daily sync when due; otherwise report the status with `ran: false`.
Mark the account's notifications read; `204`.

Start a restore flow, refusing an installation that is not empty.

The new cookie replaces the browser's previous flow cookie, so that flow and its
unfinished jobs are ended rather than left holding a slot until they expire.

put.description: Stream one bounded archive into the job's private staging.

post.description: Validate the archive and stage it; the job becomes ready with a redacted plan.
Restore the previewed archive. Activation checks the target is still empty.

get.description: Return active state, explicit saved fields, and independently resolved next state.

put.description:
Persist a complete valid desired state without hot-applying it.

Only an explicit Base URL field can stage a session-scope transition.  A port
save may change a local effective origin on the next launch, but must retain
forms sessions under the approved port-only rule.

get.description: Expose the preference only for a packaged macOS app instance.

schema.title: Response Get Dock Settings Api Settings Macos Dock Get

put.description: Save a Dock preference for the running launcher to pick up.

post.description: Validate a restart request and ask the controller to activate pending settings.

put.description: Test credentials before storing them, so a failed setup changes nothing.

post.description: Validate supplied/current connection values without persisting changes.

put.description:
Replace the instance defaults; users' copies, overrides, and policies follow.

An edit that changes any user's enforced policy needs the owner's password in
`reauthentication` and is audited per changed user (see
`filter_policy_api.admit_instance_policy_changes`) in the edit's transaction.

post.description:
Apply the caller's effective defaults, including any enforced policy, to draft copies.

The body is saved content (or a draft of it), never the enforced review view.
Find reachable completed scans using only source-server media facts.

Whether Recover Scans could find anything: a reachable completed scan of another
file of the same work. Reads no media and writes nothing.
Associate only scans and media independently authorized from their source records.

get.description: Return the libraries the caller may open, with connection failures mapped to HTTP errors.

schema.title: Response Api List Jellyfin Libraries Api Libraries Get

get.description:
Fetch, authorize, filter, sort, and page items in a Jellyfin library.

Items the caller may not reach are dropped before totals, facets, export
state, and the page are computed.
Return a reachable catalog item with its scan and export state.

get.summary: Api List Jellyfin Library Item Children
get.description: Return the reachable direct children of a reachable Jellyfin item.

schema.title: Response Api List Jellyfin Library Item Children Api Library Items  Item Id  Children Get

get.description: Return the reachable seasons of a reachable Jellyfin series.

schema.title: Response Api List Jellyfin Series Seasons Api Library Items  Item Id  Seasons Get

get.description: Resolve an old bookmark from saved bindings, including non-current Jellyfin IDs.
Look up a stable title, projecting only the viewer's reachable bindings.

post.description: Assign a version ID to a selected, authorized and readable live source.

get.description: Report the caller's active fingerprint work.

schema.title: Response Fingerprint Queue Api Media Fingerprints Queue Get

post.description: Report transcript readiness for an authorized source and target track.
Prepare an actor/file-bound preview without changing their reviews or scans.
Attach only the confirmed mapped cues to an authorized exact target.

get.description: Discover verified sidecars without requiring a saved review to be selected.

post.description: Queue a scan from a Jellyfin item, never from a browser-supplied path.

schema.title: Response Api List Scan Queue Api Scans Queue Get

post.description: Order the jobs this caller sees; jobs hidden from it keep their places.

delete.description: Cancel queued or active scan work and wake the queue processor.

schema.title: Response Api List Scan History Api Scans History Get

delete.description: Delete a scan only after checking every review and export reference.

get.description: List the references this caller may view; deletion still counts every one.
Return observed tracks and only the approved unambiguous preselection.

post.description: Validate the exact file/track snapshot before accepting a selection.

schema.title: Response Api List Jellyfin Reviews Api Library Items  Item Id  Reviews Get

post.description: Preview one filter without creating or modifying a review or scan.

put.description: Persist a review draft if its revision still matches the saved review.

patch.description: Rename a saved review at the requested revision.

delete.description: Delete a review that has no file the caller can see; others need /deletion.

post.description: Preview retimed review filters without changing the saved revision.
Create an independent copy of a saved review at the requested revision.

get.description: Render the audio preview for a saved review filter.
Render the video preview for a saved review filter.

post.description: Publish an EDL sidecar for the requested saved review revision.

get.description: Report issues that must be resolved before exporting a review as MCF.

post.description: Publish an MCF sidecar after strict preflight validation.
Download the same prepared bytes without creating directories or export rows.
Return only admissible source metadata; local filenames are never source identifiers.
Render a capped plain-text sample from the exact saved review and source.
Require the exact preview, then reauthorize and atomically publish one sidecar.

get.description: Preview the review's visible published files and the choices the caller holds.

post.description: Delete the previewed review, retaining or removing each listed file in one commit.
Retired: revision downloads no longer restore review scans (ADR 0002).
Create or reuse this caller's credits detection scan for the target media version.

Apply model consent and resume the pending credits scan.

Consent continues a waiting job, so it needs the job's resume action, and
acquiring the model needs `models.download`.
Validate an edited credits boundary and return review draft additions.

get.description: Render a short verified video clip around a credits boundary.

post.description: Import an uploaded MCF for the requested media target.

schema.title: Response 422 Api Import Mcf Upload Api Mcf Imports Upload Post

post.description: Import an uploaded EDL for the requested media target.

schema.title: Response 422 Api Import Edl Upload Api Edl Imports Upload Post

get.description: List visible scans. Explicit links require access to the current target as well.

schema.title: Response Api List Library Item Scans Api Library Items  Item Id  Scans Get

get.description: Read managed export statuses for a Jellyfin media version.

delete.description: Delete the legacy adjacent sidecar of a Jellyfin media version the caller may reach.

get.description: Serve Jellyfin artwork for an item the caller may reach.

schema.title: Response Api List Path Mappings Api Settings Path Mappings Get
Response Api Reorder Path Mappings Api Settings Path Mappings Reorder Post

get.description: Advertise backend-supported models so every client renders the same choices.
Return the supported MCF families, categories, and labels.
Read the instance settings applied to future scans.

put.description: Save the instance's preferred settings for future scans.

get.description: Return authenticated, manifest-backed storage state with no cache paths.

post.description: Start one deduplicated background acquisition for an available backend.

delete.description: Remove exactly one idle regenerable artifact, never durable application data.

jellyfin_blocked.description: The deleted account's Jellyfin user is now blocked

AccountDeletionResult.description: The per-resource result; `replayed` marks a retry of a completed deletion.

files_moved.title: Files Moved
files_moved.description: Personal files moving to the destination's export ID

policy_files.title: Policy Files

disable_cause.description: Why a disabled account is disabled; `unlinked` means it has no Jellyfin link

read_only_fields.title: Read Only Fields

successor_refusal.description: Why ownership transfer to this account would be refused now; null when it would be allowed or the caller cannot transfer ownership to it

disable_cause.description: Why a disabled account is disabled; `unlinked` means it has no Jellyfin link

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: Avatar digest for cache keys, or null

AccountSummary.title: AccountSummary
AccountSummary.description: The approved Users-list columns. Preferences appear only in a detail read.

ActorKind.title: ActorKind
ActorKind.description: Who acted. `UNATTRIBUTED` is reserved for rows that predate attribution.

AudioSelectionRequest.title: AudioSelectionRequest
AudioSelectionRequest.description: A track for one file, named by a Jellyfin item and version.

AuthenticationStatusResponse.title: AuthenticationStatusResponse
AuthenticationStatusResponse.description:
Setup state and, when signed in, the session's own account and capabilities.

`display_name` is its profile name, else its username. `jellyfin_user_id` is
the Jellyfin user the account is linked to. `access` lists what it may
attempt and its permission revision.

BulkAccountDeletionResponse.title: BulkAccountDeletionResponse
BulkAccountDeletionResponse.description: Every target in request order; earlier applied targets stay applied.

jellyfin_user.title: Jellyfin User
jellyfin_user.description: For a linked account: `allow` lets the Jellyfin user's next sign-in create a fresh account; `block` keeps that Jellyfin user from signing in or being imported until the owner unblocks them. A local account ignores it.

media_access.description: The selection to store; `inherit: true` returns to the default

BulkRequest.title: BulkRequest
BulkRequest.description: One operation for up to 100 accounts; `role` or `media_access` as the action needs.

CapabilityPayload.title: CapabilityPayload
CapabilityPayload.description:
What the signed-in principal may attempt, before per-target narrowing.

Clients hide controls from this list and refetch when `permission_revision`
changes. The server still checks every request.

CopyPreferencesUpdate.title: CopyPreferencesUpdate
CopyPreferencesUpdate.description: The complete copy: every rule, and a severity for every subcategory not enforced.

DeploymentConfiguration.title: DeploymentConfiguration
DeploymentConfiguration.description: Current HTTP generation and separately resolved persisted desired state.

DeploymentSavedOverrides.title: DeploymentSavedOverrides
DeploymentSavedOverrides.description: Only explicit persisted fields, keeping an absent override visible as null.

DeploymentSnapshotDto.title: DeploymentSnapshotDto
DeploymentSnapshotDto.description: Safe public representation of an immutable deployment snapshot.

DeploymentUpdate.title: DeploymentUpdate
DeploymentUpdate.description: One field-selective update to persisted deployment overrides.

DisableCause.title: DisableCause
DisableCause.description: Why a disabled account is disabled; an active account has none.

EditAction.title: EditAction
EditAction.description: Kodi Simple EDL actions Editarr can create from a finding.

EffectiveRule.title: EffectiveRule
EffectiveRule.description: One rule as it applies to the user. A disabled rule is shown but never applies.

Empty.title: Empty
Empty.description: `{}` for actions that take no input.

FilterCandidateAvailability.title: FilterCandidateAvailability
FilterCandidateAvailability.description: Whether a Recover Scans search could find a candidate for the item version.

FilterPolicyUpdate.title: FilterPolicyUpdate
FilterPolicyUpdate.description: The complete set of instance rule IDs and subcategories enforced on one user.

FilterPreferencesView.title: FilterPreferencesView
FilterPreferencesView.description:
A user's effective filter defaults with the provenance of each value.

`revision` guards edits to the user's values and `policy_revision` names the
enforced policy. `mode_locked` is true while any policy is enforced, so the
user may not choose their own mode.

FindTarget.title: FindTarget
FindTarget.description: `{source, item_id, media_source_id}` as the local API receives it.

ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest
ImportRequest.description: Exactly one of `all: true` or a nonempty `user_ids` list.

InstanceDefaultsUpdate.title: InstanceDefaultsUpdate
InstanceDefaultsUpdate.description: Replacement instance defaults; the password is needed when they change enforced policy.

JellyfinLibrary.title: JellyfinLibrary
JellyfinLibrary.description: The normalized library fields Editarr needs to build its navigation.

JellyfinMediaItem.title: JellyfinMediaItem
JellyfinMediaItem.description: A normalized Jellyfin item, retained independently from local scan state.

JellyfinSettings.title: JellyfinSettings
JellyfinSettings.description: Safe settings shape returned by Editarr APIs; it never exposes a key.

JellyfinSettingsUpdate.title: JellyfinSettingsUpdate
JellyfinSettingsUpdate.description: Write-only connection fields for Editarr's Jellyfin integration.

JellyfinSignIn.title: JellyfinSignIn
JellyfinSignIn.description: The Jellyfin credentials of the identity to link. Never stored or audited.

LibraryJumpGroup.title: LibraryJumpGroup
LibraryJumpGroup.description: A run of a sorted library listing a client can jump to, such as a letter or decade.

LinkCleanup.title: LinkCleanup
LinkCleanup.description:
Old-file outcomes of the account's latest link that switched its identity.

`pending` old files are not settled yet; recovery retries them at startup and
hourly while `state` is `removing`. `kept` files held bytes Editarr did not write
and were left in place; `absent` files were already gone.

LinkPreview.title: LinkPreview
LinkPreview.description: What confirming the link changes. `blockers` must be empty to confirm.

LinkProofRequest.title: LinkProofRequest
LinkProofRequest.description: Prove the caller and the Jellyfin identity to link to one account.

LinkResult.title: LinkResult
LinkResult.description: `removing` means the link committed and some old files await recovery.

LivePreferencesUpdate.title: LivePreferencesUpdate
LivePreferencesUpdate.description: The complete live-mode values. Omit enforced rules and severities.

LiveRuleOverride.title: LiveRuleOverride
LiveRuleOverride.description: Switch off and/or edit one inherited rule; `rule` keeps the inherited rule's ID.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description: A Jellyfin user's name and password; the name only selects whom Jellyfin checks.

ManagedModelArtifact.title: ManagedModelArtifact
ManagedModelArtifact.description: Authenticated view of one manifest-controlled, regenerable artifact.

MediaSourceKind.title: MediaSourceKind
MediaSourceKind.description: A local media source. Jellyfin libraries are the only kind.

ModelActionResult.title: ModelActionResult
ModelActionResult.description: `status` is the inventory, null for a caller who may download but not view it.

ModelCapability.title: ModelCapability
ModelCapability.description: A platform-specific, side-effect-free model capability declaration.

ModelDownloadState.title: ModelDownloadState
ModelDownloadState.description: The acquisition state for one capability, without local path details.

ModelStorageStatus.title: ModelStorageStatus
ModelStorageStatus.description: Model-management response.  It intentionally contains no cache filesystem path.

NotificationsRead.title: NotificationsRead
NotificationsRead.description: Exactly one of `notification_ids` (at most 100) or `all: true`.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Capability to allow, deny, or inherit

PreferencesRequest.title: PreferencesRequest
PreferencesRequest.description: Strict JSON numbers and booleans; a string or boolean threshold is refused.

PreviewInput.title: PreviewInput
PreviewInput.description: The manual-sharing draft plus the master link and required version choice (§7).

ProfileFields.title: ProfileFields
ProfileFields.description: Optional profile values. In a change, a listed `null` clears the field.

Reauthentication.title: Reauthentication
Reauthentication.description:
Proof sent inside a fresh-interactive request and verified in that request.

The password is the account's Jellyfin password, checked by Jellyfin. It is
never logged or audited.

RequestValidationErrorResponse.title: RequestValidationErrorResponse
RequestValidationErrorResponse.description: Path-safe shape returned by the global request-validation handler.

RestartCapability.title: RestartCapability
RestartCapability.description: The supported in-app restart state shared by Settings and the controller.

ReuseAnchor.title: ReuseAnchor
ReuseAnchor.description: One matched playback time, scoped to a continuous interval.

ReviewCommunityMembership.title: ReviewCommunityMembership
ReviewCommunityMembership.description:
One included community filter snapshot in a save request.

`{source_id}` keeps a stored snapshot, `{source_id, refresh: true}` takes a new
snapshot from the same link, and `{link_id}` includes a link with a new snapshot.
Saved snapshots that a request leaves out are removed.

ReviewCommunitySource.title: ReviewCommunitySource
ReviewCommunitySource.description:
A stored community filter snapshot and how it compares with its link now.

`state` is `current` (the link's active filters still equal the snapshot),
`changed` (they differ; a refresh would bring the changes in), `alignment_required`
(the link awaits alignment, so it can't be refreshed) or `link_unavailable` (the
link was deleted, replaced or belongs to another account). The snapshot's filters
are normal review filters, whatever the state; `filter_count` counts the ones the
master served when it was taken.

ReviewDeletionPreview.title: ReviewDeletionPreview
ReviewDeletionPreview.description: Only files the caller may see; hidden publications are retained unannounced.

ReviewFilter.title: ReviewFilter
ReviewFilter.description:
A review filter from a scan (`source_scan_id`) or from an included community
snapshot (`community_source_id` and the master's `community_filter_id`).

ReviewFilterCommunity.title: ReviewFilterCommunity
ReviewFilterCommunity.description:
Read-only provenance of a review filter that came from a community snapshot.

The filter itself is a normal review filter; whether the user edited it is its
`community_edited`. `label` names the community version, `removed` means the master
no longer served it at the last refresh ("Removed from community"), and
`locally_verified` that the filter's own bounds overlap a finding of the same
category from a completed local model scan of the review's version.

message.title: Message
message.default: This review uses a scan that no longer exists.

ReviewTargetRequest.title: ReviewTargetRequest
ReviewTargetRequest.description: A Jellyfin item version that an import or credits detection writes to.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Capability to grant (true), withhold (false), or reset to the catalog (null)

SavedReviewFilter.title: SavedReviewFilter
SavedReviewFilter.description: A saved review's filter with read-only edit provenance.

scan_duration_as_of.title: Scan Duration As Of
scan_duration_as_of.description: Server timestamp of the duration sample while a scan is running.

Scan.title: Scan
Scan.description: A Editarr scan, numbered independently for each Jellyfin video item.

ScanCapabilities.title: ScanCapabilities
ScanCapabilities.description: Legacy selectable lists plus detailed native model capability records.

ScanMatchSearch.title: ScanMatchSearch
ScanMatchSearch.description:
A catalog item, and optionally one of its versions, to find scanned copies of.

The server reads the item again; `media_source_id` or `source_path` only
selects one of the versions it reports. The other fields are ignored.

scan_duration_as_of.title: Scan Duration As Of
scan_duration_as_of.description: Server timestamp of the duration sample while a scan is running.

ScanVerificationCoverage.title: ScanVerificationCoverage
ScanVerificationCoverage.description: Source finding IDs covered by a derived scan, with totals per source channel.

ScopeBody.title: ScopeBody
ScopeBody.description: A local scope: every source, the listed sources, or (`inherit`) the live default.

SetupRequest.title: SetupRequest
SetupRequest.description: First-run setup: a Jellyfin server and one of its administrators' sign-in.

SignInOptions.title: SignInOptions
SignInOptions.description:
Sign-in entry points shown to a visitor.

`jellyfin` is true while a Jellyfin connection is configured.

StatusChange-Output.title: StatusChange

SuccessorRefusal.title: SuccessorRefusal
SuccessorRefusal.description: Why an account cannot become the owner.

UserMediaAccess.title: UserMediaAccess
UserMediaAccess.description: `scope` for a local account; None for a linked one, whose media Jellyfin decides.
